connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Authentication Type*Choose how to authenticate with AWSAccess Key & SecretIAM Role (for EC2/ECS/Lambda)AWS Access Key ID*Use the Access Key ID of the IAM user that can access your S3 bucketAWS Access Key ID is requiredAWS Secret Access Key*Use the Secret Access Key paired with the Access Key IDAWS Secret Access Key is requiredAWS Region*Region of the S3 bucket, e.g. us-east-1S3 Bucket*Name of the bucket that stores the Q Developer CSV files.S3 bucket name is required.IAM Identity Store IDOptional. Provide if you want DevLake to resolve user display names (format d-xxxxxxxxxx).IAM Identity Center RegionOptional. Required only when Identity Store ID is provided (e.g. us-east-1).ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access Q Developer directly.Custom Rate LimitSet a fixed hourly rate limit if you need to throttle collection speed (default 20,000). requests/hour
